title: Galen's ethical and Platonic works in Arabic: Peri ēthōn (De moribus, Arabic epitome) and Compendium Timaei Platonis; RU: «О нравах»; «Краткое изложение „Тимея“»
author: Galen
size: De moribus c. 12k words; Compendium c. 8k words (estimates)
edition: Compendium: Kraus & Walzer, Plato Arabus I (1951), Arabic + Latin. De moribus: Kraus 1937 epitome (not re-verified). Both copyrighted.
ru_evidence: ru.wiki «Гален» Russian list: absent. Solopova 2018 lists only Western editions and studies.
en_evidence: De moribus: Mattock 1972 (listed in Solopova 2018). Compendium: no English translation located; Latin 1951 only; Das 2021 is a study.
other_translations: Latin: Kraus–Walzer 1951. French: Festugière & Tonneau 1952 (study and translation).
value: Galen's lost moral psychology and his Middle Platonist reading of the Timaeus. Valuable for historians of philosophy and of Plato's reception.
pilot_unit: Compendium Timaei, all extant fragments, c. 8k words (estimate).
